- 9:30–10:00 AM PT: technical phone session. Candidate handled system design prompts well, demonstrated clear trade-off thinking. No live coding due to phone format; asked a few clarifying questions about latency/cost trade-offs that mapped nicely to our product.
- Action: send take-home coding exercise (40–60m) + 1-week turnaround. I attached the spec we discussed earlier.
- Expense: candidate submitted a rideshare screenshot. Naomi — please approve expedited reimbursement (REQ-7422).
- Next steps: if take-home is good, schedule panel loop (45–60m) next week.

Notes on tone/fit: personable, communicates clearly under stress (power outage), strong infra mental model. Recommend we move forward to take-home.
